data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): the 5 permutations MUST explicitly include the no-parent (orphan story) path AND the parent-ticket-show-failure path, each asserting the helper exits 0 (not non-zero) with 'prohibited' + non-empty reason — because the helper runs on every implementation-plan invocation and a non-zero exit would break Step 1 planning for ordinary non-flag stories. Verify: grep -qiE 'no.?parent|orphan|parent.*fail|exit 0|\$\? ' tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
